description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
When Myr Retriever enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Retriever.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr Retriever token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Myr Retriever token dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
